codex2 planning evidence only: STORY1741 readiness map posted canonically after reading full spec/all4comments, pin main a01a6989984ee2c6261074fa5f9d415719d3130a, clean and unchanged. Report /tmp/codex2-story1741-readiness-map.txt.

Preserved three signed slices: (1) markerless Git/common-dir discovery + adoption/ inert schema/local locator/version, (2) owned deterministic ignored projection + reader/hook/harness integration, (3) inventory-only migration/local-owned uninstall/explicit CI revision bootstrap/docs. No implementation before1742v1; no new trust anchor or executable plane configuration.

Grounded seams include store_locate's config-before-location cycle, actual init worktree/postclone/sibling bootstrap and product-writing scaffolder/config_commit paths, config-trust manifest + trusted default-branch reader, local exclude with tracked reinclusion caveat, Codex/Agy/Claude and Git hook writers, agent_launch context/argv/guidance-report paths. Existing report/file presence is NOT proof a harness consumes projected guidance; unsupported external adapters must say so. No adoption uninstall yet; proposed ownership-only removal cannot delete shared store/node counters/mail or edit tracked scaffolding. New watcher own_health_job/service config-block writers remain local/executable ownership, not shared adoption or an adoption install/uninstall side effect.

Main transport_profile still explicitly SANITIZATION_PENDING; actual1742 scanner/prepared mutation/outgoing history+metadata and FF-pull/E2E integration is a HARD predecessor. BUG2017 allocation_authority/work_binding not on this main, so finalized clone identity/bootstrap/store-lock integration also remains pending. No receiver/public-forward/history-export expansion. Named reusable and missing regressions in report cover actual ignored projection, tracked bytes/index/refs/remotes invariance, strict trust, mixed authored inventory, owned uninstall, concurrency/interruption and selected CI revision.

No edits/tests/builds/Cargo, claims, authority/config/service changes, synthetic mail/queue probes, verdict/status change. Mailbox emptiness not used as readiness proof. No unmatched local eff2 attestation. Ready explicitly routed PR2919 pushed-head review preempts; this planning turn complete.
subject: STORY1741 three-slice readiness map (planning only)
